sources.entry: Emby | Media server for personal streaming

summary.one_liner: Emby Server is a personal media server with client apps across many devices, exposing a REST API for client development.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Emby Server as a personal media server with apps for many platforms. It lists client apps including Android mobile, Android TV, Amazon Fire TV, HTML5, iPad, iPhone, Kodi, Media Portal, Roku, Windows Desktop, Windows Media Center, Windows Phone and Windows 8. It says the server has a REST-based API with built-in documentation, and that client libraries for that API are available. The README links to API docs and a guide for building server plugins. New users are directed to the emby.media website for installation. The README itself contains no build or install commands.
use_cases: stream personal media to phones and TVs
build a client app for a media server
watch media on Roku or Fire TV
use a media server with Kodi
how_to_run: New users: visit emby.media to install Emby Server (per README)
stack: client libraries for the Emby API
notable: Client apps on many platforms, including Roku, Fire TV, Kodi and Android TV
Built-in API documentation for client developers
caveats: README gives no build or source-install steps; installation is directed to the emby.media website
README does not state platform support for the server itself
README is brief and the links and community section have no text
